title: The Quiet Years
summary: Malfoy Manor and Privet Drive, 1982 to 1990.

title: The Letter and the Party
summary: The Hogwarts letter and Draconia's eleventh birthday, May to June 1991.

title: The Letters and the Storm
summary: The bloodline lesson at the Manor and Harry's first letters and the hut on the rock, July 1991.

title: The Way a Malfoy Shops
summary: The Malfoys' shopping day in Diagon Alley, from Knockturn Alley to Ollivanders, and Harry's arrival at the wall, 31 July 1991.

title: Harry's Morning
summary: Harry's morning on 31 July 1991: the hut, the Leaky Cauldron, the brick wall, Gringotts and the door of Madam Malkin's, with cutaways to Draconia inside.

title: Madam Malkin's
summary: Madam Malkin's robe shop, 31 July 1991: Harry and Draconia meet on two footstools, and neither of them says what they mean.

title: Ollivander's
summary: The afternoon of 31 July 1991: Draconia comes home to the Manor while Harry shops with Hagrid for books, an owl and a wand, and each of them ends the day waiting for September.

title: The Last Month
summary: August 1991: Draconia's lessons and restless evenings at the Manor while Harry spends a silent month at Number Four, each waiting for the train on 1 September.

title: Platform Nine and Three-Quarters
summary: 1 September 1991: Harry is left at King's Cross with no way to platform nine and three-quarters, while Draconia arrives on the platform with her parents, and the two end the morning on the same train.

title: The Compartments
summary: 1 September 1991: on the Hogwarts Express Draconia and her friends settle in with Pearl while Harry meets Ron, the sweets trolley and Hermione, and the two compartments head for each other.

title: Malfoy and Potter
summary: 1 September 1991: on the Hogwarts Express Draconia and her group walk in on Harry and Ron, a quarrel ends with Scabbers biting Goyle, and both compartments head for Hogwarts.

title: The Lake and the Castle
summary: 1 September 1991: the first years leave the train at Hogsmeade, cross the black lake in boats under Hagrid's lamp and wait in a small chamber for the Sorting. There Draconia asks for Goyle's bitten hand to be seen to.
